The test `an orphaned slot claimer exits once its parent process is gone` failed once on the Node 26 CI leg of #97 (run 45338085515). A re-run of only the failed job passed on the same head (`ac27782`), and #97 changed no source code (changelog flag only), so this is a timing-sensitive flake, not a regression. Expected: the test proves the orphan exit deterministically. For example, wait for the parent's exit to be observable (pidfd or poll until `kill -0` fails) and use the suite's scaled child deadline, instead of a fixed delay racing the reaper. Acceptance: - 50 consecutive runs pass under `--test-concurrency=2` on a loaded host. - The test still fails if the claimer ignores parent death. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-24T07:49:31Z) > > > > >
